Eevee

Normal

Kanto · Generation 1

Eevee is a Normal-type Evolution Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 6.5 kg. It evolves into Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon, Espeon, Umbreon, Leafeon, Glaceon and Sylveon. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (65), with a base stat total of 325.
